peer_matches.query_passage: There are three reasons Indore is a good test bed. Its central area has almost no slopes, which stretches battery range on every charge. About 120,000 college students live within a short ride of Vijay Nagar, producing lots of brief journeys. Finally, no rival sharing company operates in the city today, so the first users will build their routines around VoltRide. The trial would be operated by a local franchisee that buys the vehicles, while VoltRide provides the platform, branding and servicing rules. This approach keeps assets off VoltRide's books and shifts depreciation exposure to the franchisee, who by our estimates recovers the investment within about fourteen months if each scooter does five trips daily. After half a year, a clear threshold decides the next step. Should average trips per vehicle pass 4.5 while damage remains below 3%, the company recruits franchisees for Nagpur and Coimbatore; otherwise it brings the scooters home to Pune, having spent under ten million rupees.

Submissions will be scored on insight, rigour, feasibility and clarity of communication.
